title: Head-movement decoding
statement: For every head movement $s$ (left, stay, or right) and every bit string $x$, reading the two-bit code for $s$—$11$ for left, $00$ for stay, and $10$ for right—followed by $x$ succeeds and returns $(s,x)$.
replaced:
For every head movement $s$ (left, stay, or right) and every bit string $x$,
the head-movement reader applied to the two-bit dictionary code of $s$ ($11$,
$00$, or $10$ respectively) followed by $x$ succeeds and returns $(s, x)$.
